steps.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia

steps.label: adjourned from day to day
steps.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25

steps.label: entirely new frame of government
steps.quote: the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government

steps.label: delegates debated
steps.quote: the delegates debated, and redrafted the articles of the new Constitution

steps.label: chief points at issue
steps.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
